title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
summary: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.
body: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了一批来自俄罗斯的违规账户。这些账户利用AI技术虚构了一个以色列智库及所谓的“主权”指数，用以发表赞美俄罗斯、批评西方的言论，反映了大模型在网络安全与地缘政治舆论战中的治理挑战。原始信息显示：OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI披露并打击了一起利用生成式AI伪装智库进行隐蔽影响力的俄罗斯关联活动。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
